## Summary

Four criteria cover the new hours in the saved reply for delayed orders and the corrected reply to customers who got the old hours. A person sees the first three in a demo.

| Id | Criterion | Planned check |
|---|---|---|
| ac-1 | The saved reply for delayed orders lists the support hours as 8:00 to 20:00. | Demo: Read the new hours |
| ac-2 | The reply states that the hours apply every day, on weekends and public holidays too. | Demo: Read the new hours |
| ac-3 | The reply states that support is closed on 25 December. | Demo: Read the closed day |
| ac-4 | Each customer who got the reply with the old hours receives a corrected reply that lists the new hours. | Tests |
